I cannot buy chemical fertilizer because I do not have the cash for a full bag, and who would I share it with on this small piece of land? I will put the manure I collected from my goats on the mounds instead, and I will plant the same cassava stems and small yam setts I saved from my last harvest. My daughters and grandchildren will help me with the clearing and weeding, so I do not need to hire anyone, and I will not waste money on spray or irrigation when the rains are coming.
